about: FP32 arithmetic outputs on the GPU for every pair (binary ops) and every triple (fma) of the 15 specials, in itertools.product(specials, repeat=k) order, one 8-hex-digit word per case. Identical on an L40S (sm_89) and an H100 NVL (sm_90), CUDA 12.4 and 13.3, -ftz=true and -ftz=false; every NaN result is 7fffffff.
